law_name: Copyright Act (Act No. 185/2015 Coll. on Copyright and Related Rights)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous/pseudonymous works: 70 years from lawful publication)
moral_rights: S.18(2): disclosure, attribution, integrity; s.18(3) not waivable or transferable, end at author's death; s.18(5) revocable limited consent to interference
orphan_works: Orphan Works Directive 2012/28/EU: libraries, archives and museums may use them after a diligent search
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of exceptions (InfoSoc Directive art. 5; DSM Directive 2019/790: text and data mining, teaching, preservation)
enforcement_body: Ministry of Culture of the Slovak Republic
